mechanism: Naltrexone antagonizes opioid receptors which may blunt the rewarding effects of lisdexamfetamine and reduce its therapeutic efficacy, while amphetamines can increase cardiovascular stimulation in the presence of naltrexone's opioid antagonism.
action: Monitor for reduced ADHD symptom control and increased cardiovascular effects; consider alternative ADHD medications or naltrexone dosing adjustments under close supervision.
